journeys.title: Interactive Infrastructure Exploration
journeys.trigger: Developer lands on root homepage from terminal tool or developer community.
steps: Visitor arrives at / and interacts with the reactive infrastructure canvas
Visitor connects microservices nodes to database primitives on the virtual board
Visitor inspects real-time telemetry stream simulation in the terminal dock
Visitor reviews the 9 foundational contract gates ensuring zero build drift
Visitor scrolls to WaitlistForm component and inputs developer email
Server validates email format, enforces sliding-window rate limit, and registers record
Client displays queue confirmation badge and onboarding sequence token
journeys.outcome: Developer registered in early access queue with deployment token.

journeys.title: Compute Resource Pricing Estimation
journeys.trigger: Developer evaluates workload cost before provisioning services.
steps: Visitor adjusts CPU (vCPU) and Memory (GB) usage sliders
Calculator dynamically recomputes estimated monthly cloud expenditure
Visitor compares Hobby ($5/mo), Team ($20/mo), and Enterprise tiers
Visitor selects desired tier configuration and proceeds to waitlist registration
journeys.outcome: Developer receives customized cost breakdown and provisioning estimate.

journeys.title: Enterprise Security and Compliance Verification
journeys.trigger: Lead engineer audits platform architecture prior to production adoption.
steps: Lead visits /about and reviews deterministic build philosophy
Lead explores /blog technical articles detailing zero-drift contract enforcement
Lead inspects /privacy and /terms for intellectual property and security boundaries
Lead fills out inquiry details in /contact form requesting dedicated VPC deployment
Server validates payload, verifies CSRF token, and forwards inquiry to maintainers
journeys.outcome: Enterprise partnership inquiry logged and routed to engineering founders.
